_comment: Ground truth for the verification harness. IMPORTANT: this is no longer a snapshot of main's shipped HTML. It is this project's own build, taken after src/ was formatted with prettier. Regenerate with: npm run build, then copy dist/**/*.html over verify/baseline/, then re-run verify/make-baseline-ref.mjs.
whatThisProvesNow: A regression gate: the build has not changed unintentionally since this snapshot. It no longer proves byte-parity with main - that job is finished, and prettier formatting means the two legitimately differ in whitespace.

previousBaselines.note: Used through the re-sync and every refactor up to the prettier pass, all of which passed 18/18 with an empty allowlist - so the conversion is proven byte-equivalent to main as of that commit.

previousBaselines.kind: main's shipped HTML at the fork point
previousBaselines.note: The original migration baseline, superseded when main advanced 26 commits.

divergenceFromMainWhenReplaced: 930 whitespace-only text nodes, 160 lines of reindented JSON-LD, and 2 text nodes inside an inline <a class=email-obfuscated>. The last were measured in a browser: identical text and identical geometry, width 138.38px and left 772, in both builds.
lastChange: Re-taken after converting LG_LK to <Image>. _astro filenames carry a content hash.
